raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Root issue: RL generators prefetch each policy from the StorageVolume into a full pinned CPU copy of the weights before loading it into vLLM. GB300 generator hosts have little CPU memory and OOM on this copy.

Fix: one load path, `VLLMModelWrapper.load_model_state_dict(fetch)`, walks the FSDP groups one at a time (reshard, restore sharded params, `fetch` the group's subset in place, unshard and free; buffers last). Every parameter must be filled. `Generator.Config.model_state_dict_load_mode` picks the fetch:

| `model_state_dict_load_mode` | prefetch | fetch during load | generator host memory |
|---|---|---|---|
| `"cpu_prefetch"` (default, previous behavior) | StorageVolume -> pinned CPU copy, overlaps generation | `copy_` from the pinned copy | +1 full weight copy |
| `"gpu_fetch"` | no-op | TorchStore read straight into the GPU weights | none |

A gloo all-reduce agrees on load failure across generator ranks before rank 0 replies; on a fetch failure every rank still unshards every group (avoids an all-gather hang) and then stops the engine loop. gpu_fetch tradeoff: the transfer runs inside the load while the engine is paused rather than overlapping generation. gpu_fetch rejects quantized parameters at init. Parameters whose dtype differs from the model dtype (float32 GDN `A_log`/`dt_bias`, https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5691) are fetched into model-dtype staging tensors and cast, since the trainer sends the model dtype and torchstore requires matching dtypes. The trainer-side duplicate copy (https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/issues/5654) was removed by https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5659.

Requires https://github.com/meta-pytorch/torchstore/pull/252 (merged).

Test plan:
- CPU: `pytest tests/rl/unit_tests/cpu` with no GPU: all pass (gpu_fetch load path covered by `test_vllm_wrapper`/`test_generator`, incl. float32 param staging).
- GPU (GB200): `torchrun --nproc-per-node=2 -m pytest tests/rl/unit_tests/gpu/test_bitwise_parity.py::TestBitwiseParityQwen35DebugVarlen`: 5 passed on both ranks. Trainer vs vLLM prefill and decode are bitwise identical, including a reload through `load_model_state_dict` after CUDA graph replay.
- E2E async RL on GB200 through TorchStore (before merging main):
  - Qwen3 debugmodel, gen TP2, 4 steps: logprob_diff/max 0.0099-0.012 in both modes.
  - Qwen3 8B, gen TP1, 5 syncs: logprob_diff/max 0.21-0.31 in both modes (same as before this PR; untrained weights, not batch invariant).

Generator memory, Qwen3 8B, gen TP1:

| mode | host RSS | GPU growth in sync | sync time |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cpu_prefetch` | 24.7 GiB (16 GiB pinned copy) | +1 GiB on first sync only | 0.48 s, overlapped with generation |
| `gpu_fetch` | 3.8-3.9 GiB | 0 | 1.1-1.2 s, engine paused |

Lines changed: impl +306/-88, tests +436/-100, CI 0.

**Verdict: Needs discussion** -- The problem (GB300 generator hosts OOM on the pinned CPU copy) is real and the design is sound. But the flag is broken until torchstore#252 lands, torchstore is unpinned, and two other open PRs add knobs to the same weight-fetch path. Maintainers should settle the merge order and the overall design.

**What this PR does.** It adds `Generator.Config.fetch_model_state_dict_to_gpu`. When it is on, the generator skips the pinned CPU copy, and `prefetch_model_state_dict` does nothing. The load then calls `ts.get_state_dict(strict=False)` once per FSDP group, writing straight into that group's reallocated sharded GPU params, then unshards the group. After the load, a gloo all-reduce agrees on failure across ranks before rank 0 replies.

**Example.** 8B, TP1, numbers from the PR description:
```
staged (default):  prefetch -> 16 GiB pinned CPU copy (RSS 24.7 GiB); load = H2D copy, 0.52 s/sync
direct (new flag): prefetch no-op (RSS ~3.8 GiB); load = per-group RDMA into GPU params, 1.2-2.3 s/sync
                   with hot_swap=True, in-flight requests stall for those 1.2-2.3 s
```

### Must fix
1. **Merge order.** CI installs torchstore from `git+...torchstore.git@main` (`.github/scripts/validate_release_gpu.sh:119`); there is no pin. With torchstore before #252, the direct load raises on the second group, and CI cannot detect that (per the description). Hold this PR until meta-pytorch/torchstore#252 has merged.
2. `torchtitan/rl/generator/vllm/model_wrapper.py:279` -- a new private FSDP `_to_sharded()` call, without a TODO.
3. `torchtitan/rl/generator/generator.py:498` -- `torch.cuda.current_stream()` in engine-agnostic code; use `torch.accelerator`.
4. `torchtitan/rl/generator/vllm/model_wrapper.py:407`, `engine_loop.py:143`, `registry.py:135` -- internal defaults duplicate the config default; make the arguments required.
5. `tests/rl/unit_tests/cpu/test_generator.py:638` (and L547, L614, L835, `test_vllm_wrapper.py:483`) -- these tests check plumbing or repeat other tests; delete them (about 120 lines).

### Should consider
- `torchtitan/rl/generator/vllm/model_wrapper.py:562` -- express the staged `load_state_dict` as `load_state_dict_direct` with a `copy_` fetch, so there is one per-group load sequence instead of two.
- `torchtitan/rl/generator/engine.py:97-109` -- make `load_model_state_dict_direct` abstract instead of raising at the first sync.
- `tests/rl/unit_tests/gpu/test_bitwise_parity.py:932` -- skip the inherited batch-invariance tests in the Direct subclass to save GPU CI time.

### Questions
- **Overlap.** #5484 (felipemello1) rewrites the same pinned-buffer block (`model_wrapper.py:489-504`). On the staged path it keeps attention scales and makes unpublished keys fail. #5585 (wwwjn) adds `Generator.Config.fetch_weights_per_module`, also per-module gets on the same fetch. Merged together, the three PRs give three independent knobs on one transfer, and `system.py:133` already has `TODO: move to a model state dict transport`. Should these become one transport config, chosen by config type, where staged and direct are siblings instead of a bool checked in three places (Generator prefetch, `EngineLoop`, `VLLMModelWrapper.__init__`)? And which PR lands first?
- Is the staged path meant to remain long term? Once trainer-side staging goes away (#5659 / #5654), is there a plan to overlap the direct fetch with generation, so that hot_swap doesn't stall?

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Failure handling: an exception in `_load_model_state_dict` propagates out of the main loop's `try` (`engine_loop.py:383-389`) on every rank after the all-reduce, so all ranks fail together and rank 0 fails the pending load replies. A failed fetch still runs `_reshard`/`_restore`/`_unshard` for each later group, so the other ranks' all-gathers complete.
- Tied weights: the trainer's `state_dict()` publishes both `tok_embeddings.weight` and `lm_head.weight`, so the per-group `missing` check passes. The cost is a double fetch, as the description says.
- Smaller alternative for the flag plumbing: the engine already knows the mode, since `prefetched_model_state_dict is None`. `Generator.prefetch_model_state_dict` could check that instead of re-reading the config. A transport config (question above) would remove the bool entirely.
</details>

Each load reads the StorageVolume snapshot over TorchStore straight into the engine's GPU weights, one FSDP group at a time. The hook-based `load_state_dict` goes away. The engine then needs only one `load_model_state_dict(fetch)` method, and `EngineLoop` no longer branches.

detail.body:
Root issue: RL generators prefetch each policy from the StorageVolume into a full pinned CPU copy of the weights before loading it into vLLM. GB300 generator hosts have little CPU memory and OOM on this copy.

Fix: one load path, `VLLMModelWrapper.load_model_state_dict(fetch)`, walks the FSDP groups one at a time (reshard, restore sharded params, `fetch` the group's subset in place, unshard and free; buffers last). Every parameter must be filled. `Generator.Config.model_state_dict_load_mode` picks the fetch:

| `model_state_dict_load_mode` | prefetch | fetch during load | generator host memory |
|---|---|---|---|
| `"cpu_prefetch"` (default, previous behavior) | StorageVolume -> pinned CPU copy, overlaps generation | `copy_` from the pinned copy | +1 full weight copy |
| `"gpu_fetch"` | no-op | TorchStore read straight into the GPU weights | none |

A gloo all-reduce agrees on load failure across generator ranks before rank 0 replies; on a fetch failure every rank still unshards every group (avoids an all-gather hang) and then stops the engine loop. gpu_fetch tradeoff: the transfer runs inside the load while the engine is paused rather than overlapping generation. gpu_fetch rejects quantized parameters at init. Parameters whose dtype differs from the model dtype (float32 GDN `A_log`/`dt_bias`, https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5691) are fetched into model-dtype staging tensors and cast, since the trainer sends the model dtype and torchstore requires matching dtypes. The trainer-side duplicate copy (https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/issues/5654) was removed by https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5659.

Requires https://github.com/meta-pytorch/torchstore/pull/252 (merged).

Test plan:
- CPU: `pytest tests/rl/unit_tests/cpu` with no GPU: all pass (gpu_fetch load path covered by `test_vllm_wrapper`/`test_generator`, incl. float32 param staging).
- GPU (GB200): `torchrun --nproc-per-node=2 -m pytest tests/rl/unit_tests/gpu/test_bitwise_parity.py::TestBitwiseParityQwen35DebugVarlen`: 5 passed on both ranks. Trainer vs vLLM prefill and decode are bitwise identical, including a reload through `load_model_state_dict` after CUDA graph replay.
- E2E async RL on GB200 through TorchStore (before merging main):
  - Qwen3 debugmodel, gen TP2, 4 steps: logprob_diff/max 0.0099-0.012 in both modes.
  - Qwen3 8B, gen TP1, 5 syncs: logprob_diff/max 0.21-0.31 in both modes (same as before this PR; untrained weights, not batch invariant).

Generator memory, Qwen3 8B, gen TP1:

| mode | host RSS | GPU growth in sync | sync time |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cpu_prefetch` | 24.7 GiB (16 GiB pinned copy) | +1 GiB on first sync only | 0.48 s, overlapped with generation |
| `gpu_fetch` | 3.8-3.9 GiB | 0 | 1.1-1.2 s, engine paused |

**Verdict: Needs discussion** -- The problem (GB300 generator hosts OOM on the pinned CPU copy) is real and the design is sound. But the flag is broken until torchstore#252 lands, torchstore is unpinned, and two other open PRs add knobs to the same weight-fetch path. Maintainers should settle the merge order and the overall design.

**What this PR does.** It adds `Generator.Config.fetch_model_state_dict_to_gpu`. When it is on, the generator skips the pinned CPU copy, and `prefetch_model_state_dict` does nothing. The load then calls `ts.get_state_dict(strict=False)` once per FSDP group, writing straight into that group's reallocated sharded GPU params, then unshards the group. After the load, a gloo all-reduce agrees on failure across ranks before rank 0 replies.

**Example.** 8B, TP1, numbers from the PR description:
```
staged (default):  prefetch -> 16 GiB pinned CPU copy (RSS 24.7 GiB); load = H2D copy, 0.52 s/sync
direct (new flag): prefetch no-op (RSS ~3.8 GiB); load = per-group RDMA into GPU params, 1.2-2.3 s/sync
                   with hot_swap=True, in-flight requests stall for those 1.2-2.3 s
```

### Must fix
1. **Merge order.** CI installs torchstore from `git+...torchstore.git@main` (`.github/scripts/validate_release_gpu.sh:119`); there is no pin. With torchstore before #252, the direct load raises on the second group, and CI cannot detect that (per the description). Hold this PR until meta-pytorch/torchstore#252 has merged.
2. `torchtitan/rl/generator/vllm/model_wrapper.py:279` -- a new private FSDP `_to_sharded()` call, without a TODO.
3. `torchtitan/rl/generator/generator.py:498` -- `torch.cuda.current_stream()` in engine-agnostic code; use `torch.accelerator`.
4. `torchtitan/rl/generator/vllm/model_wrapper.py:407`, `engine_loop.py:143`, `registry.py:135` -- internal defaults duplicate the config default; make the arguments required.
5. `tests/rl/unit_tests/cpu/test_generator.py:638` (and L547, L614, L835, `test_vllm_wrapper.py:483`) -- these tests check plumbing or repeat other tests; delete them (about 120 lines).

### Should consider
- `torchtitan/rl/generator/vllm/model_wrapper.py:562` -- express the staged `load_state_dict` as `load_state_dict_direct` with a `copy_` fetch, so there is one per-group load sequence instead of two.
- `torchtitan/rl/generator/engine.py:97-109` -- make `load_model_state_dict_direct` abstract instead of raising at the first sync.
- `tests/rl/unit_tests/gpu/test_bitwise_parity.py:932` -- skip the inherited batch-invariance tests in the Direct subclass to save GPU CI time.

### Questions
- **Overlap.** #5484 (felipemello1) rewrites the same pinned-buffer block (`model_wrapper.py:489-504`). On the staged path it keeps attention scales and makes unpublished keys fail. #5585 (wwwjn) adds `Generator.Config.fetch_weights_per_module`, also per-module gets on the same fetch. Merged together, the three PRs give three independent knobs on one transfer, and `system.py:133` already has `TODO: move to a model state dict transport`. Should these become one transport config, chosen by config type, where staged and direct are siblings instead of a bool checked in three places (Generator prefetch, `EngineLoop`, `VLLMModelWrapper.__init__`)? And which PR lands first?
- Is the staged path meant to remain long term? Once trainer-side staging goes away (#5659 / #5654), is there a plan to overlap the direct fetch with generation, so that hot_swap doesn't stall?

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Failure handling: an exception in `_load_model_state_dict` propagates out of the main loop's `try` (`engine_loop.py:383-389`) on every rank after the all-reduce, so all ranks fail together and rank 0 fails the pending load replies. A failed fetch still runs `_reshard`/`_restore`/`_unshard` for each later group, so the other ranks' all-gathers complete.
- Tied weights: the trainer's `state_dict()` publishes both `tok_embeddings.weight` and `lm_head.weight`, so the per-group `missing` check passes. The cost is a double fetch, as the description says.
- Smaller alternative for the flag plumbing: the engine already knows the mode, since `prefetched_model_state_dict is None`. `Generator.prefetch_model_state_dict` could check that instead of re-reading the config. A transport config (question above) would remove the bool entirely.
</details>

Not verified: the GPU parity and end-to-end memory numbers (needs GB200 and torchstore#252); `copy_` into `_ShardedFSDPTensor` for the unification suggestion.

**Verdict: Request changes** -- The must-fix items from the earlier automated review are resolved at HEAD. tianyu-l's Nov 1 comments are still open, because the last commit (9f8a102) came before them. The main one, unifying the two load paths, changes the engine API and the config, so the PR needs another look after it.

**What this PR does.** With `Generator.Config.fetch_model_state_dict_to_gpu=True`, the generator skips the pinned CPU copy. Each load reads the StorageVolume snapshot over TorchStore straight into the engine's GPU weights, one FSDP group at a time. A gloo all-reduce makes every generator rank agree on failure before rank 0 replies.

**Example.** 8B, TP1, numbers from the description:
```
staged: prefetch overlaps generation, 16 GiB pinned copy (RSS 24.7 GiB); load 0.52 s
direct: prefetch is a no-op (RSS ~3.8 GiB); load 1.2-2.3 s while the engine is paused
```

**Earlier automated review, resolved:** torchstore#252 merged; `_reshard` TODO (`model_wrapper.py:314`); `torch.accelerator` stream (`generator.py:500`); required args (`registry.py:199`, `model_wrapper.py:444`); abstract `load_model_state_dict_direct`; tests trimmed; batch-invariance tests skipped (`test_bitwise_parity.py:937-944`).

### tianyu-l's review
1. `model_wrapper.py:617`, unify the paths -- **Correct, and it fits within #5268's constraints.** The staged load is the direct loop with a fetch that copies from the pinned buffers. That is the same `copy_` that `nn.Module.load_state_dict` does, and it keeps the per-group allocate -> fill -> unshard/free order and the memory peak (see Details). The hook-based `load_state_dict` goes away. The engine then needs only one `load_model_state_dict(fetch)` method, and `EngineLoop` no longer branches.
2. `model_wrapper.py:599`, naming -- **Correct.** One mode has four names: `fetch_model_state_dict_to_gpu`, `load_*_direct`, `_direct_load_groups`, and `fetch_model_state_dict` (which is really the transport callable). After (1), only the config value names the mode. `fetch` stays the callable's name, and `_direct_load_groups` becomes e.g. `_fsdp_load_groups`.
3. `model_wrapper.py:401`, `other_keys` -- **Correct.** The assert on that line guarantees they are buffers. Rename to `buffer_keys` / `_direct_load_buffer_keys`, and update the docstring.
4. `engine_loop.py:505` -- **Partly correct.** Only the direct path needs the all-reduce before replying, since other ranks may still be reading the snapshot. The staged path has a related gap, though: if one rank's load raises, that rank stops alone, rank 0 replies success, and the next decision broadcast hangs. After (1), run the all-reduce on both paths (it reduces a single integer over gloo) and inline `_load_model_state_dict_direct`, which has one caller.
5. `generator.py:162`, what is the unification? -- It isn't chunked CPU prefetch, and the TODO gives no concrete plan. To overlap a direct fetch with generation, the new weights need somewhere to live while CUDA graphs still read the old ones. That means keeping the sharded buffers allocated: 1/FSDP-degree of the weights in GPU memory, taken from the KV cache, and a full second copy at FSDP 1 (#5268's OOM case). Chunked CPU prefetch would save host memory, but the transfer would still happen during the pause. The author should say what the TODO means, or delete it.
6. `generator.py:163`, first-class paths -- **Correct.** Neither path is better on both axes: 0.52 s overlapped vs 1.2-2.3 s paused, and 24.7 vs 3.8 GiB RSS. Both will stay, so drop "and drop this flag". Use a `Literal`, e.g. `model_state_dict_transfer: Literal["cpu_prefetch", "gpu_direct"] = "cpu_prefetch"`. If a variant later gets its own fields (e.g. #5585's per-module requests), switch to sibling configs selected by type.

### Questions
- Merge order with #5484 and #5585. Both are still open and touch the same pinned buffers and fetch.

<details><summary>Details: unification sketch</summary>

```python
# VLLMModelWrapper.__init__: always compute the groups; pinned buffers only for cpu_prefetch
self._fsdp_load_groups, self._buffer_keys = _fsdp_load_groups(self.model)

def load_state_dict(self, fetch): ...  # today's load_state_dict_direct body

# Generator, cpu_prefetch: the fetch reads the pinned copy
def _copy_from_prefetched(state_dict):
    with torch.no_grad():
        for key, tensor in state_dict.items():
            tensor.copy_(prefetched[key])
    return state_dict.keys()
```
- `_reshard` replaces FSDP's load pre-hook. The tied group is filled in one fetch, so its buffers are no longer allocated across the whole load.
- `test_bitwise_parity.py:302-310` already loads with a `copy_` fetch, so the staged parity class and the direct one would differ only in the fetch.
- Move the quantized rejection out of the grouping and into the TorchStore path: a `copy_` into a quantized sharded param should go through the tensor subclass as it does today (*unverified*; `test_generator_dist_moe_mxfp8.py` covers it).
- Deletes about 25 lines of hook code, `load_prefetched_model_state_dict` (abstract and vLLM implementation), and the `EngineLoop` branch. The two CPU wrapper tests (`test_load_state_dict_allocates_one_fsdp_group_at_a_time` and the direct ones) can merge.
</details>

Not verified: the GPU parity and E2E numbers. CI checks the direct path only with a `copy_` fetch, so the real TorchStore read into GPU tensors is exercised only by the author's E2E run.

**Verdict: Approve -- please address the items below before merging.** The unification in 926cd74/795aa03 resolves every open comment from tianyu-l and from the earlier automated review. What remains is a test move and refreshed evidence for the default path, which this PR now also changes. A maintainer still needs to review, because this changes how the default RL weight sync loads weights.

**What this PR does.** `Generator.Config.model_state_dict_load_mode` (`Literal["cpu_prefetch", "gpu_fetch"]`) chooses the `fetch` callable that `EngineLoop` passes to the single engine method, `load_model_state_dict(fetch)`. `VLLMModelWrapper.load_model_state_dict` then goes through the FSDP groups one at a time: reshard, reallocate, `fetch`, unshard and free, with buffers last. A gloo all-reduce makes every rank agree on failure before rank 0 replies, in both modes.

**Example.** The default path, before vs after:
```
before: model.load_state_dict(pinned, strict=True) + FSDP pre/post hooks per group
after:  for each group: _reshard -> _restore -> tensor.copy_(pinned[key]) -> unshard/free
        then buffers; all-reduce(failed) over gloo; bump version
gpu_fetch: same loop, but fetch = ts.get_state_dict(user_state_dict=group, strict=False)
```

**Resolved since the last review:**
- Paths unified: one `load_model_state_dict(fetch)`. `load_prefetched_model_state_dict`, the hook code, and the `EngineLoop` branch are gone.
- Naming: the mode lives only in `model_state_dict_load_mode`, and `_direct_load_groups` became `_fsdp_load_groups`.
- `other_keys` became `buffer_keys`.
- The all-reduce runs on both paths, and `_load_model_state_dict_direct` is inlined.
- The "drop this flag" TODO is replaced by a `Literal` with documented trade-offs.
- The quantized rejection moved to the gpu_fetch init. The cpu_prefetch `copy_` into a `_ShardedFSDPTensor` is covered by `test_generator_dist_moe_mxfp8.py`.

### Must fix
1. `tests/rl/unit_tests/gpu/test_bitwise_parity.py:953`: move `test_reload_after_generate` into the default-path class, then drop the GPUFetch class and its CI step (see the inline comment).
2. PR description: the E2E and memory numbers come from the pre-unification revision. 926cd74 changes the default cpu_prefetch load (a new loop, `_reshard`, an all-reduce per load). Before merging, re-run the Qwen3.5 async RL E2E at HEAD with cpu_prefetch, and with gpu_fetch if possible. Report the logprob_diff and the s/sync for each.

### Should consider
- `Literal["cpu_prefetch", "gpu_fetch"]` is spelled out in five production signatures (`generator.py`, `vllm/engine.py` x2, `model_wrapper.py`, `registry.py`). One alias next to `GenerationEngine` would keep them in sync.

### Questions
- #5484 and #5585 are still open and touch the same fetch. If #5585's per-module request options apply to only one mode, should the `Literal` become sibling configs selected by type, as in the earlier review?

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Default-path equivalence: `nn.Module.load_state_dict` did `param.copy_(input)` under no_grad into the registered param. After `_reshard`, that param is `fsdp_param.sharded_param`, which is the tensor the new fetch writes. Buffers come from the same `model.state_dict()` key set as the pinned dict, so the result should be bitwise identical. The tied group is now filled in one fetch instead of staying allocated for the whole load, so peak memory is the same or lower.
- `_fsdp_load_groups` now runs at init in both modes. Its "neither FSDP-sharded nor a buffer" assert can't fire, because the root is asserted to be an `FSDPModule` (`model_wrapper.py:478`).
- Bypassing `nn.Module.load_state_dict` skips the NVFP4 `_load_from_state_dict` overrides (`quantization/nvfp4/linear.py:455`, `experts.py:57`). That is harmless: they only refresh a tuple built from the non-persistent, constant `_rht_sign_vector`.
- The new all-reduce adds one integer gloo collective per load, with `.item()` on a CPU tensor and no device sync.
</details>
